summary.text: Travis Gearhart is the Libertarian candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Libertarian Party convention on March 22, 2026.
Republican incumbent Edmond Soliday and Democrat Ryan Kominakis are also on the ballot.
